en: The postcard features a colored image of a traditional house with a red tiled roof, surrounded by greenery and set against a backdrop of forested hills. The reverse side of the postcard includes handwritten text, a green German postage stamp marked '5 Reichspfennig', and postmarks from 'Bad Pyrmont'. There is printed German text referring to 'Gasthaus Langer Grund, Bad Pyrmont' and the 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont'.
